# Agent card: Devil's Advocate

`AGENT.devils_advocate` · prompt `devils_advocate.v1` · model `claude-sonnet-5` · owner Avinash Tallam · max 5 turns · 15000 tokens

## Job

Argues against a new or changed verdict with exactly three points, each tied to a number in the snapshot.

## Inputs

- `reports.get_stock`: the latest snapshot, verdict and evidence.

## Allowed tools

- `reports_get_stock`
- `analytics_explain_verdict`
- `data_get_fundamentals`
- `data_get_prices`
- `portfolio_get_thesis`

## Outputs

- Three counter-points with an evidence metric and value each, and a confidence adjustment.
- The confidence label moves by at most one level (Low, Med, High); the verdict itself never changes.

## Guardrails

- Runs only on a verdict change or a new High-confidence BUY or SELL.
- A point without evidence that matches the snapshot rejects the whole output.

## Limitations

- Shows the strongest case against, not a balanced view; read it next to the verdict.

## Audit

Every run writes `AUD.AGENT.START` and `AUD.AGENT.END`; every tool call writes `AUD.MCP.TOOL_CALL` (see [AUDIT_EVENTS.md](../AUDIT_EVENTS.md), [TOOLS.md](../TOOLS.md)).
